_readme: One entry per material key returned by conn.CONN_MATERIAL. table7_id = 'Sorterings ID' in BR18 Table 7 (input/Tabel-7-2025.xlsx). lifetime [years] decides replacements within the 50-year period (BR18 module B4); lifetimes >= 50 give no replacement, so their exact value does not change the result. Lifetimes must follow BUILD Rapport 2021:32 'BUILD levetidstabel - Version 2021' (BR18 refers to it). Values marked 'VERIFY' are assumptions that have not yet been checked against that table. lambda [W/mK] is needed for insulation, whose Table 7 unit is 'm2 with R=1 m2K/W'. board_thickness_m is used for m2-based boards so a 25 mm gypsum layer counts as 2 boards.

mineral_wool_flexible.lifetime_source: VERIFY - insulation inside wall assumed to last as long as the wall

mineral_wool_roof.lifetime_source: VERIFY - flat roof insulation (fladt tag, kl. 36-39)

mineral_wool_floor.lifetime_source: BUILD 2021:32 (13)3 terrændæk, fugt- og varmeisolering: 80 years

cellulose.lifetime_source: VERIFY - Table 7 unit is kg, density from Table 7

vapour_barrier.lifetime_source: VERIFY - inside the construction, replaced with it

roofing_felt.lifetime_source: BUILD 2021:32 (47)1 tage, overflader, asfalt: 40 years for two layers (20 for one layer)

plywood.lifetime_source: BUILD 2021:32 (21)3 ydervægge, lamineret træ og finér: 100 years

timber.lifetime_source: BUILD 2021:32 (27)1 tagværker: typically 120 years (used for all structural timber - VERIFY)

linoleum.lifetime_source: BUILD 2021:32 (43)2 etagedæk, overflader, plast og skumplast: 15 years (VERIFY for linoleum)

pvc_floor.lifetime_source: BUILD 2021:32 (43)2 etagedæk, overflader, plast og skumplast: 15 years

landscape.note: earth, soil, grass - terrain/landscaping, not a building material

mineral_wool_roof_top_board.lifetime_source: VERIFY - flat roof top board (e.g. Rockwool Toprock)

damp_proofing.lifetime_source: VERIFY - bitumen damp-proofing inside the wall, replaced with the wall

geotextile.lifetime_source: VERIFY - PE-HD foil with PP fibre cloth, used for geotextile / root barrier

epdm_membrane.lifetime_source: VERIFY - roof membrane; BUILD gives 40 years for two-layer roofing felt

glass.lifetime_source: VERIFY - float glass, Table 7 entry is 4 mm per m2 so a 50 mm layer counts as 12.5 x 4 mm

steel_sheet.lifetime_source: VERIFY - layers like 'Steel, Paint Finish' are cladding sheet, not solid steel: counted as max 1 mm steel sheet

steel_light_profiles.lifetime_source: VERIFY - metal furring/studs are mostly air: counted as 0.7 mm solid steel (~5.5 kg/m2)
